CustomField.description: Calculates the overall score for the visit report by adding up each section score and dividing by the number of sections
CustomField.formula: (VALUE(TEXT(Strategic_Routing__c)) + VALUE(TEXT(Appointment_Scheduling__c)) + VALUE(TEXT(Uses_Physician_Data__c)) + VALUE(TEXT(Focused_on_Facility_Goals__c)) + VALUE(TEXT(Use_of_Consultative_Approach__c)) + VALUE(TEXT(Use_of_Questions_and_Fact_Finding__c)) + VALUE(TEXT(Demonstrates_Effective_Listing_Skills__c)) + VALUE(TEXT(Presents_Key_Messages__c)) + VALUE(TEXT(Closes_Effectively_Asking_for_Action__c )) + VALUE(TEXT(Reviews_Data_and_Analyzes_Opportunities__c )) + VALUE(TEXT(Demonstrates_Business_Knowledge__c)) + VALUE(TEXT( Demonstrates_Passion_for_Orlando_Health__c )) + VALUE(TEXT( Assertively_Prospects_New_Clients__c )) + VALUE(TEXT( Demonstrates_Sense_of_Urgency__c )) + VALUE(TEXT( Prioritizes_Adapts_to_Change__c )) + VALUE(TEXT( Tailors_Sales_Message__c ))) / 16
CustomField.label: Overall Score
